needsBassim.question: Which baseline is the headline dollar figure on reconciliation bills: CBO current-law or the Senate current-policy (budget-enforcement) baseline? They can flip the sign (OBBBA SALT sec. 70120: +$944B vs -$143B revenue).
needsBassim.recommendation: Current-law by default, current-policy next to it, baseline named on every figure.

needsBassim.question: Where does news attention come from, and which outlets count as the news cycle?
needsBassim.recommendation: Free Media Cloud account (hex-ai@agentmail.to) as the counted signal, a fixed published balanced outlet list (left, right, wire, TV), and trade/legal coverage shown separately. Google News RSS stays as the text corpus for matching.

needsBassim.question: Approve model spend: a vision pass over ~1,300 scanned House PTR pages and 44 Senate paper reports, plus LLM passes that produce labeled inferences (Senate-rewrite counterparts, CBO prose to sections, subsidiaries to parents)? The server has no Anthropic API key; the spikes used claude -p.
needsBassim.recommendation: Yes. Measure cost on 50 pages first; uncertain cells get a flag and a second read.
options: leave paper filings out and say so

needsBassim.question: Show spouse, dependent and joint trades under the member, and lobbyists' former bosses (members named in their covered positions)?
needsBassim.recommendation: Yes to both: owner always shown, former bosses quoted from the filing, same rule for every party.
options: member's own trades only, no former bosses
trades with owner, no former bosses

decided.decision: Bills: minimum text similarity (or a shared cited provision) before a same-law match counts; the old side of a split says split_into, not removed.
decided.why: Verifier found 2 false IRA matches, one hiding the late $4B drought section.

decided.decision: Attention takes late-add flags from the bills lineage, not its own heading detector.
decided.why: 6 of 7 H.R.1 late flags were wrong; the detector fired on 35% of H.R.1 vs 13% of IRA sections, a party-tilt risk.

decided.decision: Even splits of grouped CBO lines are labeled inference; dollar signs are kept.
decided.why: CBO never made those splits; $149B for state directed payments is a cut.

decided.decision: A deficit figure cites every cell range it adds up.
decided.why: 70101 and 71119 deficit claims cited only the outlay range.

decided.decision: Trades party count is 40 R / 24 D / 1 I; every member list shows 'paper filings not yet read' until the vision step runs.
decided.why: RESULTS.md text said 41/23; unread paper filers are Khanna (D, 906 pages), McCaul, Rogers, Fleischmann, Wied, Harshbarger (R), Fetterman, Blumenthal (D).

decided.decision: One claim, one specific URL; say spouse when the spouse owns the asset.
decided.why: The Tina Smith claim cited a stub URL and left out that it was her spouse's sale.

decided.decision: Show predecessor bills (e.g. S.394 for GENIUS) as a labeled inference stage in the version timeline.
decided.why: The committee rewrite happened between S.394 and S.1582.

decided.decision: Sections split out of an existing section show as 'split from', not 'added'; flagged only if their text changed beyond the split.
decided.why: Otherwise the Senate's reconciliation restructuring looks like 33 new insertions.

decided.decision: LLM pairs leftover removed/added sections that share a title or cited law, stored as inference with the model's evidence.
decided.why: Text matching misses functional rewrites (SNAP work rules, border wall). Spend covered by model-spend.

decided.decision: Cite the cbo.gov URL and store the web.archive.org copy we read as archive_url.
decided.why: cbo.gov blocks scripts with DataDome; both are public and primary.

decided.decision: For bills with only whole-bill CBO numbers, show whole-bill facts and mandate flags; LLM-linked prose-to-section notes are labeled inferences quoting CBO's sentence and page.
decided.why: GENIUS has no per-section table.

decided.decision: Lobbying is split into 'while a bill', 'quarter of enactment' and 'after enactment'.
decided.why: 5,276 of 11,961 OBBBA filings came after enactment.

decided.decision: Show the factual total for client-quarters that named the bill plus a bill-share estimate labeled inference; never the estimate alone.
decided.why: LD-2s report one total for all issues.

decided.decision: Filings that only describe the topic are off by default and shown as dashed inference edges when turned on.
decided.why: They never name the bill.

decided.decision: A stock is tied to a bill if the company lobbied on it (LDA) or is named in its text; shown as inference with the rule attached. Sector lists become a separate weaker layer.
decided.why: One explainable rule for every bill and party; replaces hand-made sector lists.

decided.decision: Affected donors default to orgs that lobbied on the bill or are the same org as a lobbying client; SIC/NAICS sector tags are a separate labeled layer.
decided.why: Explainable and citable.

decided.decision: A subsidiary's lobbying or PAC counts toward its public parent as an inference edge naming the subsidiary and the reason.
decided.why: Visa U.S.A. -> V, Coinbase Inc -> COIN.

decided.decision: Bonds, structured notes and bank-branded funds stay out of the headline and go in a weaker tier later.
decided.why: They don't track the company's fortunes the way stock does.

decided.decision: Add a lane for fights outside the bill text: failed and never-voted amendments from BILLSTATUS, plus general-bucket news.
decided.why: GENIUS: 130 Senate amendments filed, 1 agreed, 120 with no floor action; the loudest fight was about something not in the bill.

decided.decision: No Splink for company names (rapidfuzz + LLM review gets 98%); use it later for FEC individual donors.
decided.why: Name is the only usable field for companies.

decided.decision: Phase 1 runs on bulk files; an agent retries the api.data.gov signup with headless Chrome, and only if reCAPTCHA blocks it does Bassim do a one-minute signup.
decided.why: congress.gov DEMO_KEY allows 10 requests/hour; bulk files covered every spike.
